passages.text: Then I saw a scroll in the right hand of the One seated on the throne. It had writing on both sides and was sealed with seven seals.
passages.sermon:
God sat on the throne.
God held a scroll in His right hand.
The scroll had writing on the inside.
The scroll had writing on the outside.
Seven seals closed the scroll.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον ἐπὶ τὴν δεξιὰν τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου βιβλίον γεγραμμένον ἔσωθεν καὶ ὄπισθεν κατεσφραγισμένον σφραγῖσιν ἑπτά

passages.text: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?”
passages.sermon:
A mighty angel appeared.
The angel spoke with a loud voice.
The angel asked a question.
The angel said, “Who is worthy to open the scroll?”
The angel also said, “Who is worthy to break its seals?”
passages.original: καὶ εἶδον ἄγγελον ἰσχυρὸν κηρύσσοντα ἐν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ Τίς ἄξιος ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον καὶ λῦσαι τὰς σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ

passages.text: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
passages.sermon:
No one could open the scroll.
No one could look inside the scroll.
No one in heaven could do this.
No one on earth could do this.
No one under the earth could do this.
passages.original: Καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ οὐδὲ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς οὐδὲ ὑποκάτω τῆς γῆς ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον οὔτε βλέπειν αὐτό

passages.text: And I began to weep bitterly, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
passages.sermon:
John saw a vision from God.
John stood before the throne in heaven.
John began to weep bitterly.
No one was found worthy to open the scroll.
No one was worthy to look inside the scroll.
passages.original: καὶ ἐγὼ ἔκλαιον πολὺ ὅτι οὐδεὶς ἄξιος εὑρέθη ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον οὔτε βλέπειν αὐτό

passages.text: Then one of the elders said to me, “Do not weep! Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed to open the scroll and its seven seals.”
passages.sermon:
One of the elders spoke to me.
He said, "Do not weep."
Look at the Lion from the tribe of Judah.
He is also called the Root of David.
He has won the victory.
He is able to open the scroll.
He can break its seven seals.
passages.original: Καὶ εἷς ἐκ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων λέγει μοι Μὴ κλαῖε ἰδοὺ ἐνίκησεν ὁ Λέων ὁ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ἰούδα ἡ Ῥίζα Δαυίδ ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον καὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ

passages.text: Then I saw a Lamb who appeared to have been slain, standing in the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which represent the seven Spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
passages.sermon:
I saw a Lamb.
The Lamb stood in the center of the throne.
The four living creatures surrounded the throne.
The elders also surrounded the throne.
The Lamb looked as if it had been slain.
The Lamb had seven horns.
The Lamb had seven eyes.
The seven eyes are the seven Spirits of God.
God sent these seven Spirits into all the earth.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων Ἀρνίον ἑστηκὸς ὡς ἐσφαγμένον ἔχων κέρατα ἑπτὰ καὶ ὀφθαλμοὺς ἑπτά οἵ εἰσιν τὰ ἑπτὰ Πνεύματα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀπεσταλμένοι εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

passages.text: And He came and took the scroll from the right hand of the One seated on the throne.
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Lamb who appeared to have been slain.
He stood in the center of the throne.
He approached the One seated on the throne.
He took the scroll from the right hand of the One on the throne.
passages.original: καὶ ἦλθεν καὶ εἴληφεν ἐκ τῆς δεξιᾶς τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου

passages.text: When He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp, and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
passages.sermon:
The Lamb stood in the center of the throne.
The Lamb had taken the scroll.
The four living creatures fell down before the Lamb.
The twenty-four elders also fell down before the Lamb.
Each living creature and each elder had a harp.
Each living creature and each elder held a golden bowl.
The golden bowls were full of incense.
The incense in the bowls is the prayers of the saints.
passages.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἔλαβεν τὸ βιβλίον τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα καὶ οἱ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες πρεσβύτεροι ἔπεσαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ Ἀρνίου ἔχοντες ἕκαστος κιθάραν καὶ φιάλας χρυσᾶς γεμούσας θυμιαμάτων αἵ εἰσιν αἱ προσευχαὶ τῶν ἁγίων

passages.text: And they sang a new song: “Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.
passages.sermon:
The four living creatures and the twenty-four elders sang a new song.
They sang to the Lamb.
They said, “You are worthy to take the scroll.
You are worthy to open its seals.
You were slain.
By Your blood, You purchased people for God.
You purchased people from every tribe.
You purchased people from every language.
You purchased people from every people group.
You purchased people from every nation.”
passages.original: καὶ ᾄδουσιν ᾠδὴν καινὴν λέγοντες Ἄξιος εἶ λαβεῖν τὸ βιβλίον καὶ ἀνοῖξαι τὰς σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐσφάγης καὶ ἠγόρασας τῷ Θεῷ ἐν τῷ αἵματί σου ἐκ πάσης φυλῆς καὶ γλώσσης καὶ λαοῦ καὶ ἔθνους

passages.text: You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign upon the earth.”
passages.sermon:
Jesus is the Lamb.
Jesus made people into a kingdom for God.
Jesus made people priests for God.
These people will reign on the earth.
passages.original: καὶ ἐποίησας αὐτοὺς τῷ Θεῷ ἡμῶν βασιλείαν καὶ ἱερεῖς καὶ βασιλεύσουσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

passages.text: Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels and living creatures and elders encircling the throne, and their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands.
passages.sermon:
John saw a vision in heaven.
He looked and listened.
He heard many voices.
These voices belonged to angels.
They also belonged to living creatures.
They also belonged to elders.
All of them stood around the throne.
There were very many of them.
Their number was countless.
There were myriads of myriads.
There were thousands of thousands.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἤκουσα φωνὴν ἀγγέλων πολλῶν κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ τῶν ζῴων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ ἦν ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν μυριάδες μυριάδων καὶ χιλιάδες χιλιάδων

passages.text: In a loud voice they were saying: “Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!”
passages.sermon:
Many angels, living creatures, and elders surrounded the throne.
They spoke with a loud voice.
They said, “The Lamb is worthy.”
The Lamb was slain.
The Lamb deserves to receive power.
The Lamb deserves to receive riches.
The Lamb deserves to receive wisdom.
The Lamb deserves to receive strength.
The Lamb deserves to receive honor.
The Lamb deserves to receive glory.
The Lamb deserves to receive blessing.
passages.original: λέγοντες φωνῇ μεγάλῃ Ἄξιόν ἐστιν τὸ Ἀρνίον τὸ ἐσφαγμένον λαβεῖν τὴν δύναμιν καὶ πλοῦτον καὶ σοφίαν καὶ ἰσχὺν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ δόξαν καὶ εὐλογίαν

passages.text: And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying: “To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!”
passages.sermon:
John saw a vision from God.
He heard every creature speak.
These creatures were in heaven.
They were also on earth.
Some were under the earth.
Some were in the sea.
Everything in these places spoke.
They spoke together.
They said words of worship.
They spoke to the One who sits on the throne.
They also spoke to the Lamb.
They said, “Blessing belongs to You.”
They said, “Honor belongs to You.”
They said, “Glory belongs to You.”
They said, “Power belongs to You.”
They said, “These belong to You forever and ever.”
passages.original: Καὶ πᾶν κτίσμα ὃ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὑποκάτω τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης ἐστίν καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς πάντα ἤκουσα λέγοντας Τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ τῷ θρόνῳ καὶ τῷ Ἀρνίῳ ἡ εὐλογία καὶ ἡ τιμὴ καὶ ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων

passages.text: And the four living creatures said, “Amen,” and the elders fell down and worshiped.
passages.sermon:
The four living creatures spoke.
They said, “Amen.”
The elders fell down.
The elders worshiped.
passages.original: Καὶ τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα ἔλεγον Ἀμήν καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἔπεσαν καὶ προσεκύνησαν
